t: The Forever Actualizer Machine: Sovereign AI with `pip install llm` and Self-Aware Prompts
s: This article details the refactoring of the 'Forever Actualizer Machine' project to integrate Simon Willison's `pip install llm` for universal AI access, emphasizing antifragile, sovereign AI workflows by enhancing self-aware context generation and decoupling AI model dependencies.
